accessKeyHelp: If set, the app asks for this key once per device
shoppingAddItemIdHelp: The item name is written to this state with ack=false
shoppingContentId: State that contains the current list (optional)
shoppingContentIdHelp: JSON array of objects with a name; used to avoid duplicates and to show the shopping cart markers
bringListIdHelp: Choose the Bring! list (found automatically) or type the channel id, e.g. bring.0.<list-id>
modeBringSpecial: Bring! special (adds quantities to an existing item)
removeOnRestock: Remove from the list when the stock is refilled
removeOnRestockHelp: Takes the item off the Bring! list when the stock rises above the minimum again
shoppingRemoveItemId: State that receives items to remove (optional)
shoppingRemoveItemIdHelp: The item name is written to this state with ack=false. Enables removing via the cart tick in the app and the option below
removeOnUncheck: Remove from the list when I untick the check mark in the app
removeOnUncheckHelp: Tapping the check mark in the app also takes the item off the list
bestBeforeModeHelp: Off: not used. Per product: one date on each product. Per stocking: a date for every booking of stock, the oldest is used first when removing.
bestBeforeWarnDaysHelp: Products expiring within this period are marked and listed in the data points
createCertHelp: Creates a certificate for this host (host name and IP addresses), stores it in the ioBroker certificates and selects it. Install it on your devices via the .cer download.
notifyAdapterHelp: Installed instances such as telegram, telegrammenu2, pushover, signal, whatsapp, matrix or email. Empty = no notifications
notifyTargetHelp: Chat ID for telegram, e-mail address for email. Empty = default recipient of the adapter
notifyAreaHelp: Must be an area that is already approved in telegrammenu2
notifyLow: Message when the minimum stock is reached
notifyExpiry: Daily message about expired and expiring products
labelButtonsHelp: Choose which label buttons the app shows, so it stays as short as you like
notifyInventoryDays: Remind about a stocktaking every … days (0 = off)
